summary.en: A man named Yasutaro Sasamoto is nearly killed by a falling cinder block. He believes that it's his old college friend, Taeichi Hikage, who disappeared three years ago, since he has written a murder novel with a prophecy where he kills his three friends from college. One of the friends, Takeshi Nezu, was already discovered murdered in a park, and so the two remaining friends seek Kogoro's help. Location: Beika Park Victim: Takeshi Nezu Cause of death: Stab wound Suspects: Taeichi Hikage A package arrives for the other friend, Toshituku Kamio, which explodes though it only causes minor injury. Hikage then attempts to run over Sasamoto, but from the brake marks Conan questions the criminal's actual intent.
